newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank says 6-month parent forecast unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank says 6-month parent forecast unchanged.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd president Yoshiro Yamamoto expects his bank to post a 40 billion yen parent current profit and a 40 billion yen parent net profit in the six months ending September 30.

"Our forecast figures haven't changed from the ones we announced before. We still see a six-month parent current profit of 40 billion yen and a six-month parent net profit of 40 billion yen," Yamamoto said in an interview.
Yamamoto also said he expects the bank to post a full-year parent net profit of 70 billion yen in 1996/97 as it forecast in May, while continuing to dispose of problem loans aggressively.
In 1995/96, Fuji posted a parent current loss of 500.10 billion yen as it disposed of problem loans totalling about 1.1 trillion yen.
Fuji Bank has brought its bad loan problem down to a manageable level, Yamamoto said, adding: "And now, problem loans are small enough that we can cover them with our parent operating profit."
